plans.name: M12 Motorway
plans.status_now: Open since 14 March 2026 (toll-free); M7/M12 Cecil Hills interchange due mid-2026

plans.name: M6 Motorway Stage 1
plans.status_now: Delayed by 2024 sinkholes; tunnelling to resume (deal 19 Jun 2026); no confirmed opening, target end 2028 in a secondary source
plans.note: 'Stalled' is stale (tunnelling restarting) and 'third sinkhole Aug 2026' could NOT be verified; remove it. Suggest: Under construction; tunnelling resumed mid-2026 after 2024 sinkholes; no confirmed opening date.

plans.name: Fifteenth Avenue upgrade (Liverpool–Bradfield transit corridor)
plans.status_now: Planning/approval; early works end 2026, construction from about June 2027, completion about June 2031; $1.4b
plans.note: Official project is 8.1 km (Fifteenth Ave Devonshire Rd to Cowpasture Rd, plus Hoxton Park Rd to Banks Rd); the Bradfield extension is future only, so the drawn line west of Devonshire Rd is concept. Suggest: early works late 2026; main construction mid-2027; finish 2031.
